projects.name: Wells Fargo JPA Financial Model
projects.description: Developed a Java backend application using Spring Data JPA and Hibernate to manage structured financial data. Designed relational mappings between advisors, clients, portfolios, and securities, implementing database constraints, entity relationships, and data integrity controls.

projects.name: ESP32 Biometric Login System
projects.description: Developed a hardware-integrated authentication application using ESP32-CAM and a Flask backend. Implemented real-time communication through Socket.IO, JWT-based session management, and secure access to a web dashboard, integrating embedded processing with backend services.

projects.name: Sentinel Triage
projects.description: Built a security event processing and incident triage system that correlates endpoint and authentication events into actionable incidents. Integrated Sigma detection rules and MITRE ATT&CK mappings to organize security findings, reduce repetitive alerts, and support structured investigation workflows.

projects.name: ContextForge
projects.description: Developed a self-hosted documentation assistant supporting Markdown files, PDFs, and web content. Implemented document ingestion, information retrieval, source citations, and confidence-based responses through a containerized service, demonstrating full-stack integration and document processing capabilities.

projects.name: Cloud Data & Deployment Workflow
projects.description: Developed a cloud-based data processing and deployment workflow using Google Cloud Platform and BigQuery. Used Terraform for infrastructure provisioning, Docker for containerization, and GitHub Actions for CI/CD automation, connecting data processing, application workflows, and cloud deployment.

projects.name: SpecSage
projects.description: Built a document search and question-answering application over the IETF RFC archive. Implemented section-level citations, retrieval evaluation, and automated checks for source accuracy and response reliability, with a reproducible testing framework for assessing system performance.
